profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Retail sales associate turned software engineer with experience in Ruby on Rails, React, HTML, and CSS. I love problem-solving and seeing ideas come to fruition. 
As a former English major, I enjoy clever wordplay as much as I enjoy clever (and well-organized) code. I also enjoy working on projects that allow me to showcase some of my creativity.
